creativeThesis: A tactile-looking paper proof: every transformation reveals a mathematical relationship.
viewerExperience: An everyday sheet surprises, a square fails, then the viewer sees why the right rectangle succeeds.
emotionalTarget: Quiet delight and understanding, rather than awe at large quantities.
visualThesis: Warm pale paper, vermilion cut marks and forest-green edge annotations; generous space and precise choreography. Sheets feel physical through shadows, but models remain disclosed.

decisions.treatment: Original SVG/CSS paper choreography, proportional geometry and original abstract printed artwork.
decisions.rationale: Exact transformations carry the proof; generative imagery would add ambiguous shape changes.
alternativesConsidered: Live tabletop footage: appealing but requires a camera setup and obscures exact edge correspondence.
Photoreal generated paper montage: weaker temporal geometry fidelity.

decisions.treatment: Cream work surface, near-white sheets, dark green mathematical ink, vermilion cut line. Manrope sentence-case typography with no dashboard framing.
decisions.rationale: Distinguish paper objects, operations and annotations; warm print character follows the object, not a domain palette.

decisions.treatment: Kokoro-local af_heart, speed 0.96; short clip-level pauses around operations.
decisions.rationale: Current primary narrator; precise but accessible explanation requires room to watch.

decisions.treatment: Speech phrases in large dark Manrope, sentence case on a plain cream field beneath the proof; restrained opacity transitions, no word bounce.
decisions.rationale: Captions support silent understanding without covering transformed sheets. Exact words and qualifiers retained.

decisions.treatment: Narration only; deliberate quiet during rotations, no continuous music.
decisions.rationale: The shapes and edge correspondence require concentration. Silence lets the audience inspect the relationship; no simulated measurement sound.

decisions.treatment: Measured narration determines duration, with operation pauses and a brief final hold.
decisions.rationale: Story-led; no threshold padding or inherited runtime.

decisions.treatment: Cut and turn immediately; narration says almost to distinguish physical paper from the ideal model.
decisions.rationale: The operation creates the question in frame one rather than a title-card promise.

decisions.treatment: Master critical content inside surviving provisional playback insets; caption/native/crop geometry remains unknown. Target profiles bound before render.
decisions.rationale: Local master preflight informs later adaptations without claiming mobile safety or preparing publication.

recentAssets.learnedPrinciple: A visible mechanism should resolve the opening question; captions complement necessary objects.
recentAssets.applicability: Applies to proof clarity, not a prescribed color, material, hook or duration.
similarities: Original explanatory geometry and designed captions.
differences: Pale graphic paper field rather than traffic terrain, watch theatre or chocolate cutaway.
No ambient/tactile bed; identity comes from edge continuity and printed composition.
Mathematical counterexample rather than experimental/historical progression.
recentAssets.rationale: New story-specific paper construction selected before implementation; infrastructure reuse does not import historical treatments.

convergenceReview.conclusion: No convenience-driven renderer, palette, timing or sound reuse. Existing Manrope license supports readable print typography; consciously chosen for this composition.

ownerReview.rationale: Routine internal V3 direction within established narrator, rights, local tooling and cost; no exceptional departure.

risks: Rotations must visibly preserve geometry; no morphing shortcut.
Ideal/physical rounding disclosure must be legible.
Caption and proof annotations must not compete.

provenance.notes: Session-authored and source-validated decisions under owner cycle-start authority. No separate LLM/provider run or owner direction approval fabricated.
